channel.title: launcher :: Go Kure — Launcher
channel.description: launcher is a Go library that turns an OAM-style application document into the Kubernetes objects it describes, built on kure. kurel is the supported command-line tool on that library. launcher stops at the generated objects: a downstream consumer decides how they are delivered and reconciled. Two ways in You want to Start with Render an application document to YAML from a terminal Install kurel, then the Quickstart Generate objects from your own Go program Use launcher as a Go library, then the OAM Model reference What goes in, what comes out An application document names typed components. A ClusterProfile supplies the choices a cluster makes (which ingress controller, which issuer). kurel build resolves the two together:

item.title: Getting Started
item.description: Pick the route that matches how you use launcher: Command line. Install kurel, then follow the Quickstart to build your first application. Go library. Install the module, then follow the library quickstart to run the same pipeline from your program. Introduction explains the two-config-set model both routes share, and Examples lists runnable application documents.

item.title: Concepts
item.description: The launcher design, the OAM data model, and the decisions behind them. Read in this order: Model and Layers: the documents, components, traits, policies and lowering, traced from one authored document to the objects it builds. Design: why launcher is a library with a command-line tool on it, and how it relates to kure. Delivery Scope: what the library, kurel and a downstream consumer each own, and what is not implemented. It is a dated design record, so check its status line before relying on a section. API Group & GVK, Cluster Profiles and Parameter Syntax: the formats you author. The remaining pages in the sidebar are design records for single decisions.

item.title: API Reference
item.description: Reference documentation for launcher’s public Go packages. Each page below is auto-synced from the package README.md. For the full Go API, see pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-kure/launcher. CLI Package Description Reference kurel CLI kurel command tree, flags, and usage pkg.go.dev OAM Package Description Reference OAM Model OAM data model, parser, and transform pipeline pkg.go.dev Component Models Configuration-defined component models: document format and loader pkg.go.dev Component Handlers Built-in component types (webservice, worker, cronjob, helm, helmrelease, helmtemplate, …) pkg.go.dev Trait Handlers Built-in traits (ingress, certificate, scaler, externalsecret, …) pkg.go.dev Policy Handlers Built-in application policies (dependency, placement) pkg.go.dev Built-in Registry Every built-in handler and lowering rule, for registering the builtins pkg.go.dev Libraries Package Description Reference Errors Structured error types and wrapping helpers pkg.go.dev Patch Engine Declarative JSONPath patching (TOML/YAML, strategic merge) pkg.go.dev
